quick.summary: Why nobody looks at your team screen, and how to fix it.
quick.takeaway: Only include metrics that help someone make a clear decision.

beats.line: I put thirty charts on our team screen. Why does nobody look?
Think about driving a car down the highway.
You only need to know your speed and fuel level.
Extra dials would just distract me from the road.
Right. Too much detail makes people look away.
You want to avoid cognitive overload.
Can I just say keep it simple?
Yes. Keep it simple and focused on action.
So every chart should help someone make a choice?
Exactly. If it does not change a decision, cut it.
I will delete everything except our three key goals.
Now you have a screen people will use.

quiz.question: What is the best reason to add a chart to a team screen?
options: It helps someone make a choice.
It took a long time to build.
The data updates every five minutes.
It shows how hard the team works.
quiz.explanation: A good metric drives action. If the information does not change behavior, it is just noise.

quiz.question: More information on a screen always leads to better decisions.
quiz.explanation: Too much detail distracts the viewer. Removing extra charts makes the important ones stand out.
